claims: March 19 is celebrated as Día del Hombre in several Latin American countries and Mexico.
Día del Hombre on March 19 is celebrated to recognize the positive role of men in society and the family.
Día del Hombre on March 19 is often celebrated in the context of San José.
The Día Internacional del Hombre is on November 19.
March 19 is a popular celebration date in the region.
